g.text: windows.

g.text: 3 Within-pass spatial weights

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: At map point x, ai = exp{−8[(Δx/W)² + (Δy/H)²]} within window i;

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: ai=0 outside.

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: For phase p and pass k: fpk = Σi ai I(p passes in i) / Σi ai. Missing

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: phase fits give zero passing support. Observations in overlapping

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: windows are correlated.

g.text: 4 Equal-pass aggregation

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: Fp = mean_k fpk across passes covering x. Placement disagreement

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: = max_k fpk − min_k fpk; fewer than two passes gives zero.

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: Mean rank is computed only where a phase candidate exists,

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: selecting its best passing fit or otherwise best rejected fit. Fit

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: presence is reported separately. None of these fields is a confidence
